list: the official 55 trophies, verified live 19 Nov 2026

trophies.guide: This is the trophy for earning the other 54, so there is no trick to it beyond finishing the whole list, and the honest way to think about it is as a 200-hour project rather than a single task. The long pole is A Long Road, the gold trophy for 100% completion, because the checklist behind it asks for 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all eight bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations, and that grind is most of the platinum's length. Everything else falls into place around it if you follow the roadmap in this guide: play the story first, then the side stories, then the crime and activity trophies, then the collectibles, and let the 100% checklist mop up the rest. There are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals, so nothing is gated behind other players or a hard mode. Two habits protect the whole run: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and never use cheats on your trophy save, because cheats are expected to switch off trophies and saving. When the last trophy before this one pops, the platinum follows at once, and the game will have taken you through every corner of Leonida to get there.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Around 200 hours, no online or difficulty trophies, 100% checklist contents: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and finish it, and this bronze trophy pops as the mission ends. It is the first story trophy most players will earn, and it cannot be missed: it is part of the main story, it comes early in Chapter 1, and there is no way to play past it without completing it. Treat it as the start of the story run rather than a task to plan around. The mission introduces Jason and Lucia and the world of Leonida, and once it is done you are free to keep pushing the story or to poke around the map, though the sensible order is to keep playing the story for now and save the free-roam cleanup for after the credits. One thing worth doing while you are still in Chapter 1 is the optional balcony meditation with Lucia, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears when the chapter ends, so do not rush past the early story beats without checking for it. Beyond that there is nothing to prepare, nothing to buy and no skill to practise: finish Gone Fishing, watch the trophy pop, and move on to the rest of Chapter 1. It is the gentlest possible start to a 55-trophy list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Opening mission, Chapter 1: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and this bronze trophy pops, usually as the next chapter begins rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it arrives a beat late. The chapter itself is unmissable: play the story missions in order and you will get there. What makes Chapter 1 worth slowing down for is not this trophy but the one thing in it you can lose. Lucia's balcony meditation, an optional moment at Jason's house after she comes home, counts toward Positive Mental Attitude, and it is gone once Chapter 1 ends, so check the kitchen in the morning, follow her out to the balcony when she heads there, and accept the optional task. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter until the meditation is done, because there is no mission replay to go back with. Beyond that, Chapter 1 is also a good time to beat Cal at fishing and to finish an arcade game, since both of those trophies are available early and cost little, but neither is missable. Just enjoy the opening, do the meditation, and let the chapter trophy come to you as the story moves on. The chapter's missions are short and varied, so enjoy them at your own pace, and remember that the balcony meditation is the only thing in Chapter 1 that will not wait for you.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Chapter trophy timing, balcony meditation in Chapter 1: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and this bronze trophy pops, again possibly as Chapter 3 begins rather than on the final cutscene. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up, and two unlocks inside it matter for the rest of the list, so learn them as they arrive. Character switching opens right after the mission Breakfast Run, which also earns its own trophy, and once you can switch between Jason and Lucia you can call the other one in as your partner, which the partner trophies need. Later in the chapter, the mission Daily Driver unlocks the Vice City Real Estate app, where the eight garages for Little Boxes are bought, and the mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app, where the ten vehicle registrations for On the Spot are done. None of those trophies needs to be finished in Chapter 2, but knowing the apps exist saves confusion later. Also in Chapter 2, the Kolt and Associates bowling alley at Kingpin Bowling is worth visiting with Sticky Bombs for Let's Go Bowling. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, play the missions in order, and the trophy will come on its own. The two apps that unlock in this chapter are worth opening as soon as they appear, because knowing how they work early saves confusion when the trophies that need them come around later.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Character switching after Breakfast Run, garages after Daily Driver, Scooter Bros in Moses: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3 and this bronze trophy pops as the chapter closes. Chapter 3 is the busiest chapter for trophies that need doing at the right moment, so it pays to be alert while you play it. The one time-sensitive job is Race Against Yago, in Yago's street racing strand: it carries an hourglass icon, and you should save first and then race the moment it appears, because the strand counts toward Strangers and Freaks and a missed window makes that silver trophy harder. Chapter 3 is also when the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies, which Sneakthief needs, so take the mission when it comes and remember that kicking a back door in sets off the alarm while the Snap Gun does not. With your partner available since Chapter 2, the three-shops-in-a-row robbery for Retail Therapy is doable now too. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, do the Yago race the moment it shows up, and otherwise play the story through: the chapter trophy itself is unmissable. Chapter 3 also opens more of the map, so learn the new areas as the story carries you through them, because the exploration trophies will ask you to know Leonida well.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Race Against Yago time-sensitive in Chapter 3, Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4 and this bronze trophy pops as the story moves toward its finale. Chapter 4 is where the biggest robbery tools arrive, so it is worth knowing what unlocks before you reach the end. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of the chapter, opens bank vault robberies: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open, and bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone. That mission is the doorway to Maximum Withdrawal, for robbing five bank vaults, and to Hot Together, because escaping a vault gives you a four-star Wanted Level straight away, which is exactly what that trophy wants. Chapter 4 is also your last chance to tidy up anything chapter-bound before the finale, so this is the moment to make a fresh manual save, separate from your rotating saves, and to keep it untouched. Once the chapter is done there is only the final mission left, and after that the whole map stays open for cleanup. Before the chapter ends, double-check that your manual saves are in order, because the finale is close now and an untouched save from just before it is the one safety net the game gives you.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Bank vaults through That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4, partner needed: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Play the final mission and finish it, and this gold trophy pops. It is one of only two golds in the list, and it is unmissable as long as you finish the story, but it deserves more preparation than any other story trophy because of what surrounds it. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so the final mission can only be played once per save, and that makes your save discipline matter: keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission, in a slot you do not overwrite, so that if anything goes wrong you can go back without replaying the game. The game gives you 15 manual save slots plus one autosave, which is plenty if you rotate the rest and protect that one. Once the mission is done and the credits roll, the trophy is yours and the whole of Leonida stays open: the side-story finales, the collectibles and the 100% checklist all remain available, and the checklist itself only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. So finish the finale, enjoy the ending, and then start the long cleanup with the roadmap in this guide. The finale is also the moment the 100% checklist unlocks, so once the credits roll, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and look at what is left, because that list is now your roadmap for the rest of the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. No mission replay or New Game Plus, 15 manual save slots, 100% checklist after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run and this bronze trophy pops. It sits early in Chapter 2, and it matters more than most mission trophies because of what it unlocks: character switching opens right after Breakfast Run, so once the mission is done you can switch between Jason and Lucia, and you can call the other one in as your partner. That partner system is the key to several trophies, including Hot Together and Retail Therapy, which both need your partner beside you, and to Positive Mental Attitude, where meditating with your partner along is the efficient way to work through the spots. So treat Breakfast Run as a doorway rather than a checkbox: finish it, then take a moment to learn the switch controls and the partner call, because you will use them for the rest of the game. The mission itself is unmissable story content, so there is nothing to prepare and no way to fail the trophy permanently; play the story in order and it will come. If you are following the roadmap in this guide, this is the point where the game stops being a solo story and starts being a two-character one, and the trophy marks that change. Switching is quick once you learn it, and the partner call is the button you will press most often in the second half of the game, so practise it now while the stakes are low.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Character switching opens right after Breakfast Run: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist and this bronze trophy pops. It is a story mission, so it is unmissable: play the story in order and it will come to you, and there is no special preparation, no item to buy and no skill to practise first. What is worth knowing is where it sits in the shape of the story. The Cartel Heist is one of the big set-piece missions in the middle of the game, and it is the kind of mission that shows why the game asks you to keep manual saves: with no mission replay, a story mission can only be played once per save, so if you want to replay a favourite mission later you will need a save from before it. That is a matter of taste rather than trophies, since the trophy itself only needs the mission finished once. If you are working through the story trophies in order, this one falls between the chapter trophies and the side-story finales, and it is a good reminder to check your saves as you go: one at the start of each chapter, one untouched from just before the final mission, and the rest rotating. Finish the heist, take the trophy, and keep playing.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Story mission, no mission replay: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play and this bronze trophy pops. Like the other mission trophies, it is unmissable story content: play the missions in order and it will arrive on its own, with no preparation needed and no way to lock yourself out of it. The name is a joke the game makes at its own expense, and the mission is one of the story beats that fills in the middle chapters, so the best approach is simply to keep playing and let it come. The only general advice that applies here is the same save advice that applies to the whole story: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, and keep one untouched save from just before the final mission. If you are tracking the story trophies in this guide, Child's Play sits among the six named-mission trophies that sit between the chapter trophies and the finale, and together with Trust, The Cartel Heist, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory it marks your progress through the middle of the game. Finish the mission, watch the trophy pop, and move on to the next story beat. The mission trophies are the game's way of marking your progress, so watch them stack up in this guide's tracker, because each one is a chapter of the story finished and banked.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Story mission, no mission replay: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners and this bronze trophy pops. It is a story mission, unmissable like the rest: play through the story in order and it will come, with nothing to buy, nothing to practise and no way to miss it. Headliners is one of the named missions in the middle of the game, and its trophy is best thought of as a progress marker on the road to the finale rather than a task in its own right. The useful thing to do while you are in this stretch of the story is to keep your trophy habits tidy: check that you have a manual save from the start of the current chapter, remember that the Yago race in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive and should be done the moment it appears, and keep an eye out for stranger encounters in free roam, since those strands feed Strangers and Freaks. None of that is needed for this trophy itself, but the middle chapters are where the missable and at-risk trophies live, so playing attentively here saves a second playthrough later. Finish Headliners, take the bronze, and keep the story moving toward the next named mission. The middle chapters are also where the stranger encounters are thickest, so keep an eye out in free roam between missions, because each strand you finish now is one you will not have to hunt later.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Story mission, Race Against Yago time-sensitive in Chapter 3: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown and this bronze trophy pops. It is a story mission at Vice City International Airport, and like every story mission it is unmissable: play the story in order and the trophy arrives on its own. The airport is worth remembering after this mission, because it is also the home of Catch Me If You Can, the free-roam trophy for making an unscheduled departure from VCIA. That one is separate from this mission: it needs you to steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge, with the planes at gates E3 and E4 reported as working, then back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about a kilometre away from the airport before it pops, so do not confuse the two. For this trophy, though, there is nothing extra to do: finish the takedown, and the bronze is yours. As with all story missions, there is no replay, so if you enjoy the set-piece, keep a save from before it. Otherwise just keep playing the story, and let the mission trophies stack up as the chapters pass. The airport itself is one of the busiest places in Leonida, so learn its layout while you are here, because you will come back for the free-roam plane trophy and for the races and jobs that pass through it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Story mission; Catch Me If You Can needs a jet at a boarding bridge, gates E3 and E4: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory and this bronze trophy pops. It is a story mission, unmissable like the rest, and it sits late in the game, close to the finale, so by the time it arrives you will have most of the story trophies already. There is no preparation and no way to miss it: play the story in order and it will come. The mission's name gives away its flavour, and it is one of the last big story beats before the final mission, so it is a natural moment to check your save discipline before the endgame. Make sure you have a manual save from the start of the current chapter, and make sure you have a separate, untouched save from just before the final mission, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, and that save is your only way back if you want to replay the ending. After this mission there is very little story left, and then the whole map opens up for the long cleanup: side stories, collectibles, activities and the 100% checklist. Finish the operation, take the bronze, and get ready for the finale. With the story nearly done, it is worth checking your trophy list one more time before the finale, because anything chapter-bound that you missed is much harder to reach after the credits roll.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Story mission, no mission replay or New Game Plus: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion and this gold trophy pops, and it is the longest single job in the game, the one that makes the platinum take around 200 hours. The checklist itself only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but work you do earlier still counts, so there is no need to wait: everything you finish on the way there is already banked. The checklist asks for 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models discovered, all eight bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a win at all 14 Top Fun drone race locations, and the rest of the story and side content. The practical way through it is to finish the story first, then work the list in passes: stunts and vehicles while driving between jobs, Challenges as they come, and the vaults, operations and races as deliberate sessions. Push Square's guide adds that there are 397 stunts in the game in total, so you need a little over half of them for the trophy and more for the checklist. There is no shortcut and no difficulty gate: it is long, not hard, and this guide's tracker shows the counters so you can watch them climb.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Checklist contents and where it appears: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026. 397 stunts in total: Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide & roadmap, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts and this silver trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress toward it so you can watch the counter climb. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, which means almost any daring driving or flying feeds the total, and the practical method is to fold stunts into everything else you do: take jumps while driving between missions, fly low under bridges when you are in a plane, and jump off high places when the chance comes. Do not stop at 250, though, because the 100% checklist needs 300, and Push Square's guide counts 397 stunts in the game in total, so there is plenty of room to overshoot. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, nothing about it is missable, and it keeps counting after the story, so the relaxed approach works: play normally, take the flashy route when it costs nothing, and check the counter now and then in this guide's tracker. If you want to finish it deliberately, pick a fast car or a plane, work a loop of known stunt jumps, and treat it as a driving session rather than a grind, because 250 sounds like a lot until you realise how often the game throws a jump in your path.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Stunt types, 300 for 100%: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026. 397 stunts in total: Push Square GTA 6 trophy guide & roadmap, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once and this bronze trophy pops. The nine types are the game's side activities, the things you can do in free roam outside the story: racing, fishing, arcade games, shooting range challenges, drone races, meditation, hunting, bowling and gym training are the shape of the list as the launch guides describe it, though the game itself is the final authority on what counts, and the trophy's own counter will tell you which types you have tried. The method is simple and cheap: as you travel the map, stop at each activity once and try it, without worrying about winning or scoring well, because the trophy only asks you to try. Fishing is available early in Chapter 1, arcade games are easy to find, and the shooting ranges and drone races open up as you explore, so a few short detours during the story will cover most of the nine. Nothing here is missable and nothing needs a high score, so this is a trophy to pick up naturally while you play, and if one type is still missing late in the game, the tracker in this guide and the game's own activity list will point at what is left.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Nine activity types: GGRecon GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges and this silver trophy pops. There are two shooting ranges, with 42 gold medals between them, and each challenge asks you to shoot targets under a time or accuracy bar, with gold needing a strong run rather than just a pass. The method is practice plus the right loadout: learn each challenge's target pattern on a bronze or silver run first, then go for gold once you know where the targets appear, and use a weapon you are comfortable with rather than the flashiest one. Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you trigger with L3 and R3, helps on the harder challenges, and Adrenaline extends it, so keep some on hand. Nothing about this trophy is missable: the ranges stay open after the story, you can retry any challenge as often as you like, and the gold medals are also needed for the 100% checklist, so the work does double duty. If a particular challenge resists you, leave it, do the rest, and come back with better weapons and more practice, because gold is a matter of familiarity more than reflexes. Each range has its own set of challenges, so work through one range completely before moving to the other, because finishing a range gives you a clear sense of how many golds are left.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Two ranges, 42 gold medals between them: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations and this bronze trophy pops. Drone races are one of the nine activity types, and each location hosts its own race, so the job is to find all 14 spots and win at least one race at each. The method is straightforward: learn the course on a first run, then race it properly, because the drones handle differently from cars and the racing line matters more than raw speed. Shortcuts through gates and tight turns save more time than straight-line speed, and a clean run beats a fast, crashing one. Nothing here is missable: the race locations stay open after the story, you can retry any of them, and the wins are also part of the 100% checklist, so they count twice. If a location is giving you trouble, try a different approach line, watch where the course bends, and remember that you only need one win per location, not a win on every attempt. Work through the map location by location, tick them off in this guide's tracker, and the trophy will pop when the fourteenth location is won. Each location has its own course, so learn the gates and the turns on a practice run first, because a drone race won on the second attempt is still a win, and the trophy only asks for one per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. 14 drone race locations: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races and this bronze trophy pops. The word different matters: winning the same race twenty times does not count, so you need twenty distinct races across the game's racing types, which include street races, drone races and other race events scattered around Leonida. The method is to race widely rather than deeply: try each race once, move on to the next, and keep a mental or written note of which ones you have won, using this guide's tracker to count. Street racing strands, including Yago's strand in Chapter 3, are a natural source, and the Top Fun drone races overlap here too, since each location's win counts as a different race. Nothing is missable: races stay available after the story, you can retry any race you lose, and there is no difficulty requirement beyond winning. If you lose a race, learn its corners and try again rather than grinding the same easy one, because variety is the requirement. Twenty sounds like a lot, but the map is full of races, and by the time you have chased the other activity trophies you will be most of the way there without noticing. The racing strands are the best source of distinct races, because each strand offers several different events, and working through a strand fills the counter faster than hunting single races.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Different races required: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge and this bronze trophy pops. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, and Cal is the fishing rival you meet through it, so the method is to go fishing, find the challenge against Cal, and out-fish him. The challenge is a contest of catches rather than a single cast, so patience and timing matter more than speed: watch the line, strike at the right moment, and keep your catch rate steady rather than rushing. Fishing is available early, in Chapter 1, which makes this one of the earliest activity trophies you can aim for, and there is nothing missable about it: you can fish again, challenge Cal again, and keep trying until you win. If you lose the first time, treat it as practice, learn how the fishing controls respond, and come back when you are comfortable. It pairs naturally with Master of None, since fishing counts as one of the nine activity types, and with the early Chapter 1 habit of doing the small things before the story carries you onward. Go to the water, take the challenge, and beat Cal. Fishing is a slow, calm activity, so treat it as a break between louder jobs, and remember that the fish you catch and the challenge you win both count toward the activity trophies.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Fishing challenge against Cal, available early: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game and this bronze trophy pops. There are four arcade games in the game, and any one of them counts, so pick the one you like best and play it through to the end. The method is simply to find an arcade, sit down at a machine, and finish a game: no high score is needed, no perfect run, just a completion. Arcade games are available early, which makes this another good Chapter 1 trophy to pick up while the story is still young, and it counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so it does double duty. Nothing about it is missable: arcades stay open after the story, you can retry as often as you like, and each of the four games is a valid target, so if one frustrates you, try another. The games are short, self-contained and forgiving, and finishing one is a matter of a few minutes rather than a session. Find an arcade, choose a game, play it to the end, and the bronze is yours, with a small reminder that Leonida has more to do than the story. The four arcade games are all different, so try each one once even though only a single completion is needed, because the one you enjoy most is the one you will finish fastest.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy and this bronze trophy pops. Andy's is one of the six side-story questlines that each end in their own trophy, alongside Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, and Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so you will play it as Lucia. The method is to follow Andy's missions through to the end: the strand opens in free roam and in the story, and each mission leads to the next, so keep answering Andy's calls and showing up when the strand asks. Nothing here is missable: the side-story finales stay available after the credits, so you can finish Andy's strand at your own pace, even after the story is done. One thing to know is that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count toward Strangers and Freaks, because they have their own trophies, so do not expect the counter on that silver trophy to move when you finish one of these. Finish Andy's last mission, take the bronze, and move on to the next side story. If you are working the roadmap in order, the side stories come in stage two, after the story, and Andy's is a good one to start with. Andy's missions are best played as Lucia, since the strand is hers, and the story they tell is one of the more personal ones in the game, so give it the time it deserves.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton and this bronze trophy pops. Kenton's is another of the six side-story questlines, and like the rest it is a strand of missions that ends in a finale: follow it through, mission by mission, until the last one is done. The side stories stay available after the credits, so there is no rush and nothing to miss: you can finish Kenton's strand during the story or in the long cleanup afterwards, and the trophy will pop whenever the final mission ends. Kenton's strand is also one of the ones that does not count toward Strangers and Freaks, since it has its own trophy, so treat the two trophies separately and do not watch the wrong counter. The practical approach is to keep an eye out for Kenton's missions as they appear in free roam and in the story, answer them when they come, and let the strand build up over time. If you are following the roadmap, the side stories are stage two, after the main story, and Kenton's finale is one of the seven trophies in that stage. Finish the last mission for Kenton and the bronze is yours. Kenton's strand rewards patience, because its missions build slowly toward the finale, and the payoff is a trophy that marks a complete side story finished from start to end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Side-story finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy and this bronze trophy pops. Billy's is one of the six side-story questlines, and like Andy's and Tyrone's it is tied to one character's strand, so follow Billy's missions through to the finale. The strand opens as you play and builds mission by mission, and the trophy pops when the last one ends. Nothing here is missable: the side-story finales stay available after the credits, so you can finish Billy's strand whenever you like, during the story or in the cleanup after it. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers and Freaks, because it has its own trophy, so do not expect that silver trophy's counter to move when you finish it. The best way to work the side stories is to answer them as they appear rather than leaving them all for the end, because spreading them out keeps the game varied and keeps you from facing a long block of finales all at once. If you are following the roadmap in this guide, Billy's finale is one of the seven trophies in stage two, the side-story stage, and it pairs naturally with the other character strands. Finish Billy's last mission and take the bronze. Billy's missions have a flavour all their own, so enjoy the ride, and remember that the strand's finale is the trophy, which means every mission before it is progress worth counting.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Side-story finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida and this silver trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress as zero out of eight so you can see how many strands you have finished. The catch is that only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies, so you need eight strands from the other strangers you meet across the state. The practical method is to check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish: if it moved, that strand counted, and if it did not, it was one of the ones with its own trophy. Work through stranger encounters as you find them in free roam and in the story, and do not leave them all for the end, because one strand is time-sensitive, and that is what makes this trophy at-risk rather than safe. Race Against Yago, in Yago's street racing strand in Chapter 3, carries an hourglass icon, so save first, then race the moment it appears, because if that strand is one of your eight and you miss its window, the count gets harder. Everything else about this trophy is forgiving: the strands stay available after the credits, and the counter tells you exactly where you stand. Finish eight counting strands and the silver pops.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Only some strands count; Yago race time-sensitive in Chapter 3: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy and this bronze trophy pops. Randy's is one of the six side-story questlines, a strand of missions that builds toward a finale, and the trophy pops when that last mission ends. Like the other side stories, it stays available after the credits, so there is nothing missable here: finish it during the story or in the cleanup afterwards, at whatever pace suits you. The method is simply to follow the strand: answer Randy's missions as they appear, play them through, and keep going until the finale. Randy's strand is one of the ones that feeds the side-story stage of the roadmap, and it sits alongside Andy, Kenton, Billy, Tyrone and Bret as the six character strands that each carry their own trophy. If you are working through them in order, it helps to spread them out across your playthrough rather than saving them all for the end, because they break up the longer grinds nicely and each one is a self-contained story. There is no special preparation, no item to buy and no skill to practise: just play Randy's missions to the end, watch the finale close, and take the bronze. Randy's strand is one of the more businesslike ones, but it still ends in a proper finale, so follow it through and take the bronze when the last mission closes.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Side-story finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone and this bronze trophy pops. Tyrone's is one of the six side-story questlines, and it is Jason-only, so you will play it as Jason. Follow the strand mission by mission until the finale, and the trophy pops when the last one ends. Nothing here is missable: the side-story finales stay available after the credits, so you can finish Tyrone's strand during the story or afterwards, and the trophy will come whenever the finale is done. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers and Freaks, because it has its own trophy, so keep the two counters separate in your head and do not be surprised when one finishes without the other moving. The practical tip for all six character strands is the same: answer them as they appear, because a strand left waiting is a strand you will have to hunt down later, and the map is large. If you are following the roadmap, Tyrone's finale is one of the seven trophies in stage two, the side-story stage, and it pairs with the other character finales. Finish Tyrone's last mission and the bronze is yours. Tyrone's strand is a good one to play as a break from the main story, because its missions are self-contained and the finale is a satisfying stop on the way to the rest of the list.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, finales stay open after the story: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida and this bronze trophy pops, and this is the one trophy in the whole list that can truly be missed, so read this carefully. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. The catch is Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning, and when she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate, follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs it, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. The other spots stay available after the story, so the rest of the job is a relaxed tour of the map: visit each purple icon, meditate, and move on, bringing your partner so each spot counts for both characters. If you miss the balcony moment, your only way back is a Chapter 1 save, which is why this guide keeps warning about it. Do the balcony meditation first, then the rest at leisure.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Balcony meditation in Chapter 1, purple icons, partner doubles spots: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026. Whether the balcony spot is strictly required is unconfirmed: OutputLag, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret and this bronze trophy pops. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only, and it sends you after animals through target decks, so the method is to follow Bret's strand, take the targets it gives you, and hunt them down one by one until the unique animal is yours. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which matters for the hunt's scoring, so take your time, aim carefully, and do not rush the shot. Hunting is one of the nine activity types, and it is a slower, quieter part of the game than the robberies and races, which makes it a good change of pace between louder jobs. Nothing here is missable: Bret's strand stays available after the credits, you can retry a hunt, and the trophy pops when the unique animal is taken. If you are following the roadmap, Bret's hunt is one of the seven trophies in the side-story stage, alongside the five other character finales and Strangers and Freaks. Bring a good rifle, study the target deck before you go out, and remember that patience is the skill this trophy rewards, not speed. Bret's targets come through decks that tell you what to hunt and where, so read each deck before you set out, because a hunt started with the right information is a hunt finished quickly.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Bret's hunting questline is Jason-only, target decks, clean head or heart shot: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Complete three Collectible Card sets and this silver trophy pops. Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida, grouped into sets, and the trophy asks for any three complete sets, so you do not need every card in the game, just three finished groups. The method is to collect as you travel: pick up cards whenever you see them, keep track of which sets are close to complete, and then hunt the missing cards for those sets deliberately. A set-by-set approach beats random collecting, because three complete sets is the goal, not a large total, so focus on the sets where you already have most of the cards. Nothing here is missable: the cards stay where they are after the story, you can collect at any pace, and the trophy pops the moment your third set is complete. It pairs naturally with The Goodtime State, since exploring all 52 areas of Leonida will carry you past many cards, and with Whip It Good, since driving everywhere to find cards also discovers vehicles. Use this guide's tracker to note which sets you are chasing, and finish three of them for the silver. Cards hide in all kinds of places, from shops to back rooms, so check every interior you enter, because a card you walk past is a card you will have to come back for later.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Three complete card sets: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations and this silver trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress so you can watch the counter climb. WAiNK is the in-game app for scanning and tagging, and the method is to use it everywhere you go: scan vehicles, tag locations, and make it a habit every time you arrive somewhere new, because the counter only moves when you use the app. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it, which feeds Whip It Good, so the two trophies grow together if you scan traffic as you drive. The practical approach is to fold WAiNK into your normal travel: every new area, every new vehicle, every new spot gets a scan, and the hundred will arrive without a dedicated grind. Nothing here is missable: the locations stay available after the story, the app works anywhere, and the counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough. If you reach the endgame and the counter is short, take a drive around the map with the app open and scan everything you pass, because the last few locations are usually the ones you never stopped at. The app is worth opening every time you enter a new area, because a location you forget to scan is a location you will have to revisit, and the hundred adds up faster when scanning is a habit.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. WAiNK scanning also discovers vehicles for Whip It Good: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges and this bronze trophy pops. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and there are 80 of them in total, so the trophy asks for 50 and the 100% checklist asks for 70, which means this trophy is a milestone on the way to a bigger number rather than a finish line. The method is to play broadly: many Challenges complete on their own while you play, because they cover driving, flying, fighting, exploring and earning, so a varied playthrough fills them in without deliberate effort. Check the list now and then, see which ones are close, and nudge the ones that need a small push, rather than grinding them one by one from the start. Nothing here is missable: Challenges stay available after the story, progress is cumulative, and you can finish them in any order. If you are following the roadmap, this trophy will often pop during the activity and crime stages, while you are racing, robbing and exploring, and the remaining twenty for the checklist can be mopped up afterwards. Play widely, check the list, and let the fifty come to you. The Challenges list is worth checking after every big session, because a challenge you finished without noticing is easy to miss, and the list tells you exactly which ones are close to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. 80 Challenges, 70 needed for 100%: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat, and this bronze trophy pops. The method is to get the police to four stars while your partner is with you, then break away and stay out of sight until the heat fades. The easiest reliable way is a bank vault robbery, because vault jobs give you a four-star Wanted Level straight away, and you need your partner along for those anyway, since you cannot carry all the bags alone. Once you are out of the vault with the police on you, drive hard, break line of sight, and get clear of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, because the trophy only pops once you have left the heat zone behind. Character switching opens after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, so you can call your partner in from then on, and the partner needs to be with you when the wanted level drops. Nothing is missable: you can build a four-star wanted level in free roam at any time, so if the vault route does not work for you, cause trouble with your partner beside you and lose the heat the same way. A good getaway car makes this trophy much easier, so pick something fast with decent handling before you start, because the escape is the hard part and the robbery is the easy one.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Vault jobs give four stars at once, trophy pops after leaving the heat zone: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level, and this bronze trophy pops. The method is to call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. The key detail is that the Wanted Level must stay up the whole time: if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks, so keep the police interested between shops and do not let the heat die. Pick three shops close together, plan the route before the first robbery, and move fast from one to the next. The trophy can take about thirty seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth. Your partner needs to be with you, which means character switching must be open, and that happens after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Nothing here is missable: shops can be robbed at any time after the story, so if the chain breaks, just try again with a better route. Choose nearby shops, keep the stars up, and rob three in a row. Plan the route before the first robbery and keep it short, because three nearby shops in quick succession are far easier than three spread across the city with the police already chasing you.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Chain breaks if the stars fade, trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles and this bronze trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress so you can watch the counter climb. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive, and the counter will grow without any dedicated effort. The method is to make scanning a habit: every new car, bike, truck or plane you pass gets a scan, and the variety of Leonida's traffic does the rest. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a bigger number, and the same habit serves both. Nothing here is missable: vehicles keep appearing after the story, the counter is cumulative, and you can scan at any time. If you reach the endgame and the counter is short, drive through busy areas and scan everything, or visit the places where rarer vehicles appear. It pairs naturally with You WAiNKer, since every scan feeds both trophies, and with The Goodtime State, since exploring all 52 areas carries you past new vehicles. Scan as you go, and the hundred will come. Rarer vehicles are worth seeking out deliberately once the common ones are done, because the checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models and the rare ones are the ones that take the longest to find.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. WAiNK scanning discovers vehicles, 200 of 277 models for 100%: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus and this bronze trophy pops. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming, and time slows down while you pick your targets. The method is to find a group of enemies close together, trigger Focus, and drop five of them before it runs out. Gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, are a good target, because they cluster together and give you several shots in one place, and an assault rifle makes the five kills easier than a slower weapon. Adrenaline extends Focus, so keep some on hand and use it if the timer feels short. Nothing here is missable: you can retry as often as you like, Combat Focus is always available, and illegal operations stay open after the story, so if the first attempt falls short, set up another group and try again. Pick a crowded spot, trigger Focus with a full group in front of you, and take five down in one slow-motion burst. It is a trophy about setup more than skill, and a good ambush makes it easy. An assault rifle with a large magazine is the best choice, because five kills in one Focus needs enough bullets to finish the job without reloading in the middle of the slow-motion window.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Combat Focus is L3 and R3 while aiming, Adrenaline extends it: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport and this bronze trophy pops. The method is to steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge: the planes at gates E3 and E4 are reported as working, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway, and take off, then fly about a kilometre away from the airport, because the trophy is delayed and only pops once you are clear of the airport. Save first, because the police come fast once you take the plane, and a save lets you retry without losing anything. Nothing here is missable: the airport and its planes stay available after the story, so you can attempt this whenever you like. The common mistake is taking a plane from the open airfield instead of a boarding bridge, so walk to the gates, find a docked jet, and use that one. Steal the jet, take off, fly clear, and the trophy will follow a short delay later. Once the trophy pops, fly on and enjoy the view, because the flight itself is a good way to see how large Leonida is, and the map you have been driving through looks very different from the air.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Jet at a boarding bridge, gates E3 and E4, fly about 1 km away: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank and this bronze trophy pops. The description is a joke about the Rhino tank, and the method is to find one, climb in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. Tanks are reported as parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map, so head there, save first, and take one. Expect attention: a stolen tank draws the military and the police quickly, so the save matters, and once you are in, driving and firing is enough to trigger the trophy. Nothing here is missable: the air station and its tanks stay available after the story, and you can retry as often as you like. If the first attempt ends in an explosion, reload the save and try a cleaner approach, perhaps at a quieter moment or with a faster escape route in mind. The trophy is one of the free-roam oddities that rewards exploring the far corners of the map, and Mile Zero is worth the trip on its own. Find the tank, get in, and drive it until the bronze pops. The air station is at the far southwest of the map, so the trip there is an exploration trophy in itself, and the drive out will carry you through areas you might not visit otherwise.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Tanks on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, far southwest island: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected and this bronze trophy pops. The method starts in Chapter 3, when the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it, because kicking the door in sets off the alarm and ruins the attempt. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is reported as a good target, with a clear route in and out. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on, because a detected robbery cannot be salvaged for this trophy. Nothing is missable: jewelry stores stay open after the story, you can retry as often as you like, and the Snap Gun stays yours once you have it. The trophy rewards patience over speed: move quietly, use the Snap Gun, read the note, open the safe, and leave the way you came without ever being noticed. A quiet robbery also keeps your wanted level down, which matters because a loud one brings the police and a police chase is the opposite of the undetected escape this trophy demands.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape, and this silver trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress so you can watch the counter climb. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner, and vault jobs give you a four-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until the heat is truly gone. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a bigger number, and the same five robberies count for both. Nothing is missable: vaults stay available after the story, you can retry any failed attempt, and each successful escape moves the counter. Bring your partner, rob the vault, escape clean, and repeat five times. Each vault you rob also pays in Marked Bills, which feeds Dime on the Dollar, so the vault grind earns two trophies at once if you remember to launder the bills through your contacts after every job.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Vaults through That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4, partner needed, 8 vaults for 100%: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape, and this bronze trophy pops. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida, and the method is to stop one, take what it carries, and get away clean. Tail the truck, force it to stop, deal with the guards, grab the money, and then escape the police, because the trophy only pops once you have left the heat behind, not just the flashing search area. Like the bank vaults, this is a robbery that rewards a good escape plan: pick a quiet stretch of road, know where you will run, and have a fast car ready. Nothing here is missable: armored trucks keep appearing after the story, you can retry as often as you like, and the trophy pops on the first clean escape. It pairs naturally with the other robbery trophies, since the same skills and the same partner help here too, and it is a good warm-up for the vaults, which are bigger versions of the same job. Find a truck, stop it, take the money, and escape without being caught. The trucks follow regular routes, so learn where they travel and pick a quiet stretch of road for the ambush, because a clean stop with room to escape beats a messy one in traffic.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Trophy pops after leaving the heat zone: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida and this bronze trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress so you can watch the counter climb. The method is to travel: drive, fly and walk into every named area on the map, from Vice City itself to the far corners of the state, until the counter reads 52. There is no single route, and the practical approach is to explore as you do everything else, because missions, races, collectibles and side stories will carry you through most of the map on their own. The gaps are usually the quiet places nothing else sends you to, so when the counter stalls, look at the map for the areas you have never visited and drive out to them deliberately. Nothing here is missable: the whole map stays open after the story, exploration is cumulative, and you can finish it at any pace. It pairs naturally with the collectible trophies, since exploring carries you past cards and WAiNK locations, and with Whip It Good, since new areas bring new vehicles to scan. Travel widely, visit everywhere, and the trophy will pop when the last area is found. The map's named areas are the unit that counts, so a place only registers when you enter it properly, and driving through on a highway without stopping may not be enough to tick it off.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. 52 areas of Leonida: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs and this bronze trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress so you can watch the counter climb. Illegal operations are the gang-run businesses scattered across Leonida, and each one belongs to a gang, so the method is to find one operation per gang, rob it, and move on to the next. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a bigger number, and the same robberies count for both. The practical approach is to work through the map gang by gang, noting which gangs you have already hit in this guide's tracker, and to save before each robbery in case it goes wrong. Nothing here is missable: the operations stay available after the story, they come back if you leave something behind, and you can retry any of them. If a gang's operation is hard to find, explore its territory and watch for the markers, because each gang's turf is where its operations live. Rob one operation from each of the nine gangs and the bronze is yours, with thirty more to go for the checklist. Each gang's territory has its own look and feel, so the nine robberies double as a tour of Leonida's underworld, and the map knowledge you gain will help with the exploration trophies too.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. Nine gangs, 39 operations for 100%: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach and this bronze trophy pops. The description is the only hint the launch guides can confirm, because no unlock method for this trophy had been confirmed at launch, so the honest advice is to go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or a spot with a view, and have a cocktail there. Ocean Beach is the beachfront strip of Vice City, full of bars, hotels and ocean views, and the trophy's name, In The Beginning, suggests it is one of the game's quiet moments rather than a task to grind. Try the beachfront bars, order a drink, and enjoy the view, and if it does not pop at the first bar, try another spot along the beach. The trophy is hidden, so it will not show on your list until it is earned, and that is normal for this one. Nothing suggests it is missable, and it is the kind of trophy that pops while you play normally if you spend time on the beach. This guide is honest about the gap: the method is not pinned down at launch, the description is all we have, and a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach is the best reading of it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase / PSNProfiles, 19 Nov 2026. No confirmed unlock method at launch, description is the only hint: OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style and this bronze trophy pops. The description is the only hint the launch guides can confirm, because no unlock method for this trophy had been confirmed at launch, so the honest advice is to find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside it, and drive it straight out through the glass in the style the old games made famous. A showroom is a car dealer's display floor, and the classic move is to take a display car and smash through the front window onto the street, which is the kind of moment the game clearly wants to reward. Try it at a showroom you find while exploring Vice City, save first in case the attempt goes wrong, and be ready for the police, because smashing out of a showroom is not a quiet exit. The trophy is hidden, so it will not show until it is earned. Nothing suggests it is missable, and it is the kind of trophy that pops from a single bold moment rather than a grind. This guide is honest about the gap: the method is not pinned down at launch, and a showroom smash is the best reading of the description.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley and this bronze trophy pops. The bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2, and the method is to bring Sticky Bombs, take all three key valuables, the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb, and then escape the police. The follow-through in the description is the bowling itself, so play a frame while you are there if you can, but the robbery is the heart of it. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable: you can return and finish what you missed. Bowling is also one of the nine activity types, so a visit here feeds Master of None as well. The practical tip is to plan the robbery before you start: know where the three valuables are, bring enough Sticky Bombs for the safe, and have an escape route ready, because the police arrive quickly. Visit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, take the valuables, bowl a frame, and escape. The three valuables are the heart of the job, so learn where each one sits before you start, because a robbery that misses one is a robbery you will have to repeat to finish properly.

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal and this bronze trophy pops. The method reported at launch is that it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength, so buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. That reading is not confirmed, so treat it as the best available method rather than a certainty: train at a gym with your partner along, work both characters up to maximum Strength, and see if the trophy follows. Gyms are one of the nine activity types, so training there also feeds Master of None, and the beach gym in the launch guides is a natural place to start. The practical approach is to make gym sessions a habit between other jobs: a few sets each visit, both characters training together, and the Strength stat climbing steadily. Nothing suggests this trophy is missable, and it is the kind of trophy that pops from a long, quiet grind rather than a single moment. This guide is honest about the gap: the maximum-Strength method is reported but not confirmed at launch, and if it does not pop, the description's talk of partnership points back to training together.

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile and this bronze trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress toward it so you can watch the counter climb. The description is deliberately vague, and the launch guides report that the counter counts actions that change your Criminal Profile, which means robberies, fights and other criminal acts feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. The method is simply to play the game the way the game wants you to: rob shops, vaults and trucks, fight rival gangs, take on illegal operations, and let the counter climb as you do the crime trophies. Five hundred sounds like a lot, but the criminal acts behind the other trophies add up fast, and by the time you have worked through the robbery and gang trophies you will be most of the way there. Nothing here is missable: the counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, criminal opportunities stay available after the story, and you can keep feeding it in free roam. If the counter stalls late in the game, go back to the crime trophies and do more robberies and operations, because every one of them moves it. Play criminally, and the five hundred will come.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try and this bronze trophy pops. The description is the only hint the launch guides can confirm, because no unlock method for this trophy had been confirmed at launch, so the honest reading is that it rewards succeeding at something after failing it once. That could be a race, a challenge, a mission, or any task with a second attempt, and the practical advice is to keep playing normally and let it come: fail something, try it again, and succeed, and the trophy should pop on the second attempt. The trophy is hidden, so it will not show on your list until it is earned, and that is normal for this one. Nothing suggests it is missable, and it is the kind of trophy that pops while you play normally, because every player fails something and retries it sooner or later. If you want to chase it deliberately, pick a race or a challenge you can fail and retry quickly, fail it once on purpose, and then win it on the second attempt, but there is no confirmation that a deliberate setup works better than natural play. This guide is honest about the gap: the method is not pinned down at launch, and a second-try success is the best reading of the description.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by and this bronze trophy pops. The description is the only hint the launch guides can confirm, because no unlock method for this trophy had been confirmed at launch, so the honest reading is in the words themselves: a drive-by is an attack from a moving vehicle, and a melee drive-by means doing it with a melee weapon rather than a gun, bowling the target over as you pass. The practical method is to get a vehicle, pick up a melee weapon, find a target in the open, and swing as you drive past, timing the hit so it connects. It is a stunt more than a fight, and it will take a few attempts to get the timing right, so save first and keep trying until the hit lands. The trophy is hidden, so it will not show until it is earned. Nothing suggests it is missable, and it is the kind of trophy that pops from a single silly moment rather than a grind. trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars laundering Marked Bills through your contacts and this bronze trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress so you can watch the counter climb. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs, and they are laundered by selling them to your contacts, so the method is to keep doing the jobs that pay in marked bills and keep selling them on, letting the total build up over time. The 250,000 total is cumulative, so you do not need it all at once, and the same bank vault and payday jobs that feed the robbery trophies also feed this one. The practical approach is to treat laundering as a habit: after every vault or payday job, sell the marked bills to your contacts before you move on, and the counter will climb steadily. Nothing here is missable: the jobs stay available after the story, the total is cumulative, and your contacts keep buying. If the counter stalls, do more vault robberies, since Maximum Withdrawal needs five vaults and the checklist needs eight, and each one pays in bills to launder. Rob, launder, repeat, and the quarter of a million will come. Payday loan jobs are the other source of Marked Bills, so take them when they appear, because the bills from a payday job launder just as well as the ones from a vault.

trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops and this bronze trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress so you can watch the counter climb. The 100,000 is cumulative across every kind of shop, so there is no single purchase to save for: clothes, weapons, food, cars, upgrades and everything else all count, and normal play will carry you a long way toward the total. The method is to spend as you go rather than hoarding: buy the weapons you need, the clothes you like, the car upgrades that help, and let the spending add up. The practical tip is to check the counter when you are near the end of the game, and if it is short, spend the difference on something useful, like weapon upgrades or a car you actually want, rather than throwing money away. Nothing here is missable: shops stay open after the story, spending is cumulative, and you can finish it at any time. It pairs naturally with Little Boxes, since the eight garages cost about 160,000 dollars between them, and that purchase alone clears this trophy. Spend widely, and the hundred thousand will come. Weapons and car upgrades are the most useful things to spend on, because they make the rest of the list easier while they move the counter, so spend on things that help you play better.

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties and this bronze trophy pops. The garages are bought in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, and together they cost about 160,000 dollars, so the method is to open the app, buy each garage, and keep going until all eight are yours. Garages the story gives you do not count, so only the bought ones move the counter. The practical approach is to buy them as you can afford them rather than saving up for all eight at once, because each garage is also a parking space you will use, and the Scooter Bros registrations for On the Spot need free garage space for each car. Nothing here is missable: the app and the garages stay available after the story, you can buy them in any order, and the trophy pops when the eighth is bought. Buying all eight also clears Treat Yo Self, since 160,000 dollars of spending is more than that trophy's 100,000, so the two trophies fall together. Open the Real Estate app after Daily Driver, buy the eight garages, and the bronze is yours. A garage is also a home for the cars you register, so buy them before you start the Scooter Bros registrations in earnest, because each registration needs a free space waiting for it.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app and this bronze trophy pops, with PlayStation tracking your progress so you can watch the counter climb. The Scooter Bros app opens in the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register, and that car is registered. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay and Spray, which is faster once it is open. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first, because a full garage blocks the next registration. The practical method is to register cheap cars you steal on the street, one after another, keeping a free garage space open for each one, and the ten will add up quickly. Nothing here is missable: the app stays available after the story, you can register at any time, and the counter is cumulative. It pairs naturally with Little Boxes, since the garages give you the space, and with Whip It Good, since the cars you steal are also vehicles to discover. Open the app in Moses, register ten cars, and the bronze is yours. Cheap stolen cars are the best registrations, because the trophy only asks for ten registered vehicles and there is no benefit to registering an expensive one, so save your money for the garages instead.
